choices.why: The tufted Chesterfield is the most classic and elegant sofa in the set and suits the ornate room, though its light grey is not the dark green velvet requested.
A pair of cream wingback chairs with nailhead trim gives a traditional, formal look and faces the sofa well on either side of the fireplace.
The large medallion wool rug is sized to sit under the whole seating group and its traditional design and muted tones suit the room.
The dark wood X-base table is a classic rectangular shape that fits the space between sofa and fireplace and matches the dark wood the user asked for.
The large gold-framed rectangular mirror is wide enough to centre over the mantel and its ornate frame suits the moulded classic room.
The turned-column lamp with a linen drum shade matches the traditional style and gives the fabric shade the user wanted.

answer.why: The Chesterfield sofa, wingback chairs, medallion rug, dark wood table, gold mirror and turned floor lamp share a traditional, elegant palette and form a cohesive classic living area around the fireplace.
